bootstrap.law: paired cluster bootstrap: ONE resample plan per surface (random.Random(sha256(master_seed:surface)[:8])) applied to EVERY arm

candidate_alphas_note: kd alphas are READ FROM the pinned candidate packets' distillation.kd_alpha at scoring time — never CLI-supplied

clusters.rule: FROZEN placeholder rule: speaker ids ending '_fleurs' are pool-level placeholders -> those rows cluster by ROW; all other rows cluster by real speaker_id (english 451 / french 470 / pidgin 25 / swahili 325 clusters). Veto surfaces always cluster by row.

metric: WER = sum(edit_distance)/sum(ref_words); edit_distance = word-level Levenshtein on whitespace tokens of (pinned reference text_normalized, receipt hyp_normalized), RECOMPUTED by the scorer — caller-supplied edit counts REFUSE
note: if the stage-1 packets are revised before launch (e.g. the 13,200 s cap repin), candidate_packets pins here are refreshed in the SAME commit — the scorer refuses any drift
purpose: FROZEN pre-results scoring packet (Codex second review 2026-08-25 finding 5): pins EVERY input of the nomination decision so no scoring choice can be made after candidate results exist. Consumed exclusively by scripts/arm2_nomination_scorer.py.

receipt_schema.authentication: every receipts file's model_sha256 must equal the arm's entry in the --arm-models map, which must carry the export model_sha256 from each arm's completion receipt; rows must cover each scored surface exactly (no partial scoring)

references_provenance: nomination-language references extracted from the exposure-index-pinned eval-dev pool manifests (fetched by exact S3 VersionId, sha-verified against the index pins) filtered to EXACTLY the frozen split identities; veto references copied verbatim from the committed B5-ARM1-LINGALA-SENTINEL-2026-001 rows (386) and the B5-UNIVERSAL-ARM1-DEV-SELECTION-2026-001 kinyarwanda/ewe rows (60+60)

split.note: the FROZEN minted nomination split (artifact sha == the attested mint output)

stage_chain: stage2 CONSUMES the committed stage-1 decision JSON (path + sha256) and DERIVES the finalist from decision.provisional_finalist; a caller-chosen finalist refuses; stage2 runs only after outcome PROVISIONAL_FINALIST
